gaps.reason: pgAdmin's cltype select carries per-type length/precision ranges (min_val/max_val) and the edit-mode cast filter (edit_types); the descriptor select cannot carry those and the hidden min_val_attlen/max_val_attlen/min_val_attprecision/max_val_attprecision fields are omitted.
foreign_tables/static/js/foreign_table.ui.js (server/options/columns) is a different field set and was not transcribed into this form.

pgAdmin depChange keeps columns.is_primary_key, primary_key.columns, foreign_key/unique column renames and partition key resets in sync, confirms before 'Of type' or access-method changes and fetches inherited columns; none of this is expressible as visible_when.

gaps.concept: Partition value editability by partition type
gaps.reason: values_from/to (range), values_in (list), values_modulus/remainder (hash) are enabled by the parent's partition_type, not by a field of the row.
only offered on 17+ by getPrivilegesForTableAndLikeObjects; a single multiselect option cannot be version-gated.
partition_key_note and partition_note are static notes; folded into help text.

fields.label: OID
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: System table?
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Unlogged?
fields.help: Corresponds to the family's table_type=unlogged variant. Read-only once the table exists.

fields.label: Columns
fields.help: Reorder is allowed in create mode only. Rows inherited from a parent table (inheritedfrom set) cannot be edited or deleted; adding is disabled while 'Of type' is set. Grid columns shown inline: name, cltype, attlen, attprecision, attnotnull, is_primary_key, defval; the rest open in the row editor.

columns.label: Primary key?
columns.help: Only shown while creating a table; toggling it maintains the Primary key constraint row.

columns.label: Position
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Data type
columns.help: pgAdmin loads get_types; in edit mode the list is filtered to the column's edit_types (implicit casts). Custom type selector not expressible (see gaps).

columns.label: Inherited id
columns.help: Hidden; parent table OID sent to the backend.

columns.label: Inherited from table
columns.help: Only shown while creating a table.

columns.label: Inherited from type
columns.help: Hidden tracking field (OF TYPE columns).

columns.label: Inherited from table
columns.help: Hidden tracking field (parent tables).

columns.label: Original Default
columns.help: Hidden; original DEFAULT from the composite type.

columns.label: Original NOT NULL
columns.help: Hidden; original NOT NULL from the composite type.

columns.label: Length/Precision
columns.help: Enabled only for types with a length; min/max come from the type list (min_val/max_val).

columns.label: Scale
columns.help: Enabled only for types with a precision; PostgreSQL allows negative precision.

columns.label: Compression
columns.help: Enabled for variable-length types only.

columns.label: Collation
columns.help: Enabled only when the type is collatable.

columns.label: Storage
columns.help: 'DEFAULT' exists on PostgreSQL 16+; before 16 the field is only shown in edit mode.

columns.label: Default
columns.help: Disabled for serial types and when the column is identity/generated.

columns.label: Not NULL?
columns.help: Forced on for identity columns.

columns.label: Type
columns.help: GENERATED needs PostgreSQL 12+ and cannot be applied to an existing column.

columns.label: Expression
columns.help: Read-only once the column exists.

columns.label: Primary key?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Foreign key?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Inherited?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: System column?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Privileges
columns.help: Privilege codes accepted by the backend: a, r, w, x. Grantee list comes from the role catalog plus PUBLIC; grantor is read-only and defaults to the connected user.

fields.label: Primary key
fields.help: At most one row; a row can be added once any column has a name. Disabled on partitioned tables before PostgreSQL 11.

columns.label: Name
columns.help: Required in edit mode.

columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: System primary key?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Comment
columns.help: Enabled once the constraint has a name.

columns.label: Columns
columns.help: Read-only once the constraint exists; disabled when an existing index is chosen.

columns.label: Index
columns.help: Only offered on an existing table (not inside table create).

columns.label: Fill factor
columns.help: Disabled when an existing index is chosen.

fields.label: Foreign keys
fields.help: Rows can be added once any column has a name. Disabled on partitioned tables before PostgreSQL 11. Grid columns shown inline: name, columns, references_table_name.

columns.label: OID
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: System foreign key?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Auto FK index?
columns.help: Create mode only; forced off while creating the whole table (pgAdmin). Read-only when an index exists.

columns.label: Covering index
columns.help: Defaults to fki_<name>; required when Auto FK index is on.

columns.label: Referenced Table
columns.help: Hidden; joined from the column rows.

columns.label: Referenced
columns.help: Columns of the referenced table (get_columns?tid=references).

fields.label: Check
fields.help: Grid columns shown inline: name, consrc.

columns.label: OID
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: System check constraint?
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Comment
columns.help: Enabled once the constraint has a name.

columns.label: Check
columns.help: Read-only once the constraint exists.

columns.label: No inherit?
columns.help: Read-only once the constraint exists.

columns.label: Don't validate?
columns.help: Read-only once an existing constraint is validated.

fields.label: Unique

columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Comment

columns.help: Only offered on an existing table (not inside table create).

columns.help: Disabled when an existing index is chosen.

fields.label: Exclude
fields.help: Rows can be added once any column has a name. Grid columns shown inline: name, columns, constraint.

columns.label: OID
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Comment
columns.help: Enabled once the constraint has a name.

columns.help: Changing it clears the column rows (pgAdmin confirms first).

columns.label: Constraint
columns.help: Predicate; read-only once the constraint exists.

columns.label: Columns/Expressions
columns.help: pgAdmin header form: Is expression / Column / Expression. Operator list depends on the column type (get_operator?col_type); operator classes depend on the access method.

columns.label: Col/Exp
columns.help: Column name (picked from the draft columns) or the expression text.

fields.label: Partitioned table?
fields.help: Read-only once the table exists.

fields.label: Partition Type
fields.help: Hash needs PostgreSQL 11+.

fields.label: Partition Keys
fields.help: Partition table supports two types of keys: Column (any column from the list) or Expression (e.g. extract(YEAR from saledate)). List partitioning accepts a single key. At least one key is required.

fields.label: Partition Scheme
fields.help: Existing PARTITION BY clause (pgAdmin note control).

fields.label: Partitions
fields.help: Create a table: multiple partitions can be created while creating a new partitioned table (Operation switch disabled). Edit existing table: create/attach/detach partitions; attach picks from the list of suitable tables. Default: stores rows that fall in no other partition. From/To/In: values must be single-quoted; several partition key values are comma separated. From/To for range, In for list, Modulus/Remainder for hash. Deleting a row detaches the partition.

columns.label: OID
columns.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

columns.label: Operation
columns.help: Editable only when adding a partition to an existing table.

columns.label: Name
columns.help: When attaching, pgAdmin offers the suitable tables (get_attach_tables) instead of free text.

columns.label: Access Method
columns.help: Disabled when sub-partitioned; alterable only on PostgreSQL 15+.

columns.label: Default
columns.help: Range and list partitions only.

columns.label: From
columns.help: Range partitions; quoted literal(s).

columns.label: To
columns.help: Range partitions; quoted literal(s).

columns.label: In
columns.help: List partitions; comma separated quoted literals.

columns.label: Modulus
columns.help: Hash partitions.

columns.label: Remainder
columns.help: Hash partitions.

columns.label: Partitioned table?
columns.help: Not available when attaching.

fields.label: Tablespace
fields.help: pg_global is excluded.

fields.label: Fill factor
fields.help: Disabled for partitioned tables.

fields.label: Inherited from table(s)
fields.help: Selecting a parent copies its columns into the Columns grid; disabled when 'Of type' is set or the table is partitioned. Properties mode shows the same id as text.

fields.label: Inherited tables count
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Is inherited?
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Of type
fields.help: Disabled when inheriting from tables; changing it replaces the column definitions (pgAdmin confirms first) and clears constraints and partition keys.

fields.label: RLS Policy?
fields.help: Please check if any policy exists. If no policy exists for the table, a default-deny policy is used, meaning that no rows are visible or can be modified by other users.

fields.label: Access Method
fields.help: Disabled for partitioned tables; alterable only on PostgreSQL 15+.

fields.label: Toast tuple target
fields.help: Disabled for partitioned tables.

fields.label: Parallel workers
fields.help: Disabled for partitioned tables.

fields.label: Has OIDs?
fields.help: Disabled on PostgreSQL 12+ (OIDs removed) and in catalogs.

fields.label: Primary key
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Storage settings
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Relation
fields.help: Disabled when 'Of type' is set. The With ... switches reset when the relation is cleared.

fields.label: Custom auto-vacuum?
fields.help: Disabled for partitioned tables.

fields.label: Autovacuum settings
fields.help: Fixed rows (one per autovacuum_* storage parameter from the vacuum settings endpoint); only Value is editable.

fields.label: Custom auto-vacuum?
fields.help: Enabled when the table has a TOAST table (or while creating).

fields.label: TOAST autovacuum settings
fields.help: Fixed rows (toast.autovacuum_* parameters); only Value is editable.

fields.label: Privileges
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Privileges
fields.help: Privilege codes accepted by the backend: a, r, w, d, D, x, t, m. Grantee list comes from the role catalog plus PUBLIC; grantor is read-only and defaults to the connected user.

fields.label: Rows (estimated)
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Rows (counted)
fields.help: Counted on demand (Count rows); shows 0 until then.
